name: Resin files: Chitubox (CBDDLP, CTB 2 to 5)
description: Writes the Chitubox family of resin files that many Elegoo, Phrozen and Creality printers read. CBDDLP and CTB version 2 are written from a format document, CTB versions 3 to 5 from a specification. Our own code, read back by CadCraft only: not yet loaded on a printer.
author: CadCraft
